Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: At 17.0 and 17.2s the creek car is at the left edge, then at 17.4s a cut to a suburban street with low beige houses, a green street sign and a white car with its wheels at the edge of a brown puddle. Floodwater covers only the left part of the road. Car is small and about a quarter of frame width. Big empty sidewalk fills the lower third.
